note: Exact workflow configuration that produced each set of cached answers. Answer files do not store the retrieval, evidence or citation settings. The `models` field was added on 2026-11-02 around 22:30: 0/53 v1 answers and 44/53 v2 answers contain it, and `judge_model` is present in 8/53 v1 judgements and 53/53 v2 judgements. Older records used the same models, listed under `common`. v1 and v2 differ on three points at once (passage ranking, evidence rule, citation rule), so the v1/v2 comparison does not isolate the effect of any single change.

common.test_set: evaluation/datasets/incidents_eval.json, split=test (53 incidents, 5 out of scope)

v1.passage_ranking: RRF top 20 candidates re-ordered by the cross-encoder (score against the incident text), top 6 kept
v1.evidence_rule: >= 2 passages with cross-encoder score >= -0.22 (calibrated on the 10 calibration incidents)
v1.citation_rule: investigator prompt without the rule restricting citations of steps and solutions

v2.passage_ranking: RRF order kept (top 6); the cross-encoder only scores the passages
v2.evidence_rule: >= 3 passages with cross-encoder score >= -2.86 (chosen on the validation set, evaluation/results/evidence_tuning.json)
v2.citation_rule: a step or solution cites a passage only if that passage states it; otherwise shown as not sourced
